caveats: Baseline window pool uses dates 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 (edge windows). Day-of-year via leap-year table (Feb29=60). Sea cells = finite on all target days (3292 of 3600). Land cells written as 0. Threshold/climatology computed in float64 from float32 stored kelvin. Per-cell MHWs = maximal hot runs >=5 days, merged when separated by 1-2 non-hot days. Event end = last active day. Mask grid is the 60x60 region subset of the dataset grid (lat 54.46-55.64, lon 16.06-17.24).
